label: by-eye key from the compiler's plaintext, not independently confirmed
plaintext_used: ايري كبير والصغير يقول لي اطعن حشاي به وكن صنديدا / ناديت هذا لا يجوز فقال لي عندي يجوز فنكته تقليدا
plaintext_note: The record's plaintext (ابري ... الاحور ... بحور وثلثه) is corrected in four words: ايري (not ابري), لا يجوز (not الاحور/الاحوز), يجوز (not بحور), فنكته (not وثلثه). The sign cipher and the tree script (63v.trees) give these readings independently: S2 (= ي in all 15 places) stands where the record has ب in ابري and بحور; S21 S1 | S2 S22 S6 S23 spell لا | يجوز, and S2 S22 S6 S23 recurs for يجوز in l.5; S24 S13 S4 S19 S16 = فنكته uses the ف ن ك ت ه shapes seen elsewhere. The margin skeleton is compatible (لايجوز written joined resembles الاحوز). A bawdy (mujun) couplet.

alignment_note: word index runs over the cipher's own groups; at the l.3/l.4 break the groups are نادي | ته | ذا (see notes)

red_check.note: no red gloss over the sign cipher; cross-checked instead with the tree script 63v.trees, whose red letters and branch-count key give the same 79 letters

verdict: consistent: 79 signs = 79 letters, 24 shapes for 22 letters, one letter per shape (100% over repeated shapes); ص has two shapes (S8, S17), ل two (S7 x6; S21 once, in لا). Requires the corrected plaintext (ايري, لا يجوز, يجوز, فنكته); against the record's plaintext 13 positions break.
notes: Line counts by eye: 15, 14, 15, 14, 15, 6 (the record's 14 and 7 for l.5-6 is a line-split difference; total 79 either way).
Dividers (stem with three dots) follow word ends except at the l.3/l.4 break: ناديت is split نادي | ت at the line end, and ت is grouped with the ه of هذا (S19 S16 | S20 S1).
ب (S5) and ت (S19) have separate shapes: not a skeleton cipher.
